 A2O LITE's 'Era of Explosion'
 SVO - A2O LITE achieved 11 wins on music shows in just 26 days with only one digital single.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 09/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 This achievement is even more remarkable considering the group accomplished it with only a digital single, without releasing a physical album. On November 8th, A2O LITE topped SBS's Inkigayo with their debut song NEON for three consecutive weeks, thus achieving a "triple crown" (three consecutive wins) on the show.
 Previously, the group also won first place on Arirang TV's Show ! K-POP on November 2nd and MBC's Show! Music Core on November 7th, bringing their total number of trophies won in the past week to three.
 You may also like This popularity is also clearly reflected in domestic and international charts. The song NEON maintained its leading position on Melon 's daily chart and 'Top 100' chart for a long time, while spending 18 consecutive days at number one before returning to the number one spot on November 7th. On Spotify 's daily chart in South Korea , as of November 6th, the song had reached number one a total of 24 times. 
 On the international market, NEON entered Billboard 's 'Global 200' chart and reached number 3 on the 'Billboard Global Excl. US' chart. In Japan, the song maintained a position in the top 10 of Oricon 's weekly streaming chart for two consecutive weeks, demonstrating the strong impact of its popularity on domestic music charts on the global market.
 You may also like The group's solid skill set also attracted considerable attention. A2O LITE varied the opening choreography in each performance, creating a unique signature with a combination of 'tutting' and 'locking' dance techniques. In their encore performance after winning, the members showcased impressive vocal abilities, harmonizing smoothly without backing music.
 Under the vision of key producer Lee Soo Man, who always emphasizes the core strength of the song itself, the group has proven its explosive popularity since their debut. Now, the public is focusing their attention on what new records the group will continue to set in the future.
